m: odana as, am, m. n. (√ ud, Uṇ. ii, 76), grain mashed and cooked with milk, porridge, boiled rice, any pap or pulpy substance, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
a: odanaḥ, -naṃ [uṃd-yuc Uṇ. 2. 76] 1 Food, boiled rice; e. g. dadhyodanaḥ, ghṛta˚, guḍa˚, māṃsa˚ &c. 2 Grain mashed and cooked with milk. 3 A cloud. (Sometimes odana is prefixed to the names of pupils to denote that the pupil's object is more to be fed by his master than be taught; e. g. odanapāṇinīyāḥ P. VI. 2. 69 Sk.) — nī The plant (balā) Sida Cordifolia. Comp. — āhvayā, -āhvā, -odanikā N. of a medicinal plant (mahāsamaṃgā).
